title: Ottoman vocabulary
summary: Read the Ottoman layer of today's Turkish: Ottoman words beside their Öz Türkçe partners, the vocabulary of the Ottoman state, law and household, what an Ottoman word signals in a modern sentence, and Ottoman Turkish in Latin transcription.
canDo: Match Ottoman words with their modern partners, and say which pairs are both alive
Recognize the vocabulary of the Ottoman state, law and household in history books and series
Hear what an Ottoman word adds to a sentence: formality, law, nostalgia or irony
Read a transcribed Ottoman sentence and rewrite it in modern Turkish
vocabThemes: the Öz Türkçe words of the language reform
